ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of all UBOs, shareholders, directors and the legal representative against OFAC SDN List, United Nations Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List, EU sanctions, as well as Colombian UIAF risk lists and domestic financial/administrative records. PEP identification and enhanced due diligence (EDD) apply where the natural person has or has had prominent public functions in any jurisdiction. Screening must be evidenced in the legal file before notarization and registration.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: RUES (Registro Único Empresarial y Social) at www.rue.com.co; name availability is reserved via the local Cámara de Comercio online platform (e.g., www.ccb.org.co for Bogotá).
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be written in the Latin alphabet, preferably in Spanish, and must contain the suffix 'S.A.S.'; foreign brand names are transliterated to Spanish phonetic orthography if needed. The name must be singular, not misleading as to activity, and distinguishable from existing registered names before the same chamber.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A rejected name reservation cannot be extended; the applicant must file a new availability request. An administrative appeal against the chamber's refusal may be lodged by filing a 'Recurso de Reposición' before the same Cámara de Comercio within 10 working days of notification, and, where available, a 'Recurso de Apelación' before the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (or Ministerial authority for macro-sensitive names). Alternatively, the applicant may reserve a different name.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office (e.g., a law firm or shared business center address) is acceptable for registration as the domicilio social, provided judicial and administrative notifications can be served there. Because the actual business is the manufacture of resin polyhedral dice, the production and warehousing will be at a separate operational location; DIAN and local commercial law require the registered office to be a genuine place of administration or to be complemented by a registered establishment (sucursal or establecimiento de comercio) at the production site.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate; estimated annual probability of 20% for unannounced inspection in the first year, arising from DIAN verification visits, Cámara de Comercio controls, and municipal (environmental/protective) inspection of resin handling and small-scale manufacturing.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Código de Comercio (Decreto 410 de 1971), Articles 110, 111 and 354; Ley 1258 de 2008, Articles 4-6, 17, 20-22 and 25-27 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada); Decreto 1074 de 2015 and Superintendencia de Sociedades Circular Básica Jurídica
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá) operating the Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES), coordinated with DIAN for NIT assignment
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private incorporation instrument) inscribed in the Registro Mercantil; an Escritura Pública (public deed) is required only when real-property in-kind contributions are made
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital under Ley 1258 de 2008; capital may be nominal and subscribed but unpaid at formation, and cash subscriptions must be deposited in a Colombian financial institution; escrow accounts are not statutorily mandated for cash contributions
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION

The initial director(s) of [Company] S.A.S., a Colombian Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada, resolve:

1. Share Subscription. Issuance and full subscription of shares at par is acknowledged; funds shall be paid into the corporate bank account.
2. Registered Office. The registered office is fixed at [Address], Bogotá D.C., and may be changed under law.
3. Officer Appointments. [Name] is appointed Legal Representative and [Name] Compliance Officer, with powers per the bylaws.
4. Registrations. The Legal Representative shall file the incorporation deed with the Chamber of Commerce and obtain the RUT with DIAN.
5. Banking. The opening of bank accounts and execution of ancillary documents are authorized.

Adopted by unanimous vote.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate name availability consultation and reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the intended domicile via the RUES online portal or physical service window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a homonymy pre-consultation requesting the Certificado de Homonimia for up to three candidate corporate names. The chamber issues a certificate evidencing that no identical or confusingly similar name is registered. The certificate remains valid for 30 business days and must be attached to the incorporation document.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Homonimia application form
Identification document of the applicant incorporator
List of proposed corporate names in order of preference
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for similarity with a registered company, request a new consultation using a distinctive alternative name; a written reconsideration petition may be filed with the chamber if the similarity grounds are deemed unfounded.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and legalization of the incorporation instrument
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public (if public deed required) or the Chamber of Commerce for authentication of private signatures
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Documento Privado de Constitución containing all statutory clauses required by Ley 1258 de 2008: shareholder identification, corporate name, domicile, term, purpose (manufacture of games and toys under CIIU 3240), capital subscription schedule, share classes, registered office, representation powers and audit provisions. All shareholders must sign; fingerprints and notarization or chamber legalization of signatures are required. If real property is contributed, execute a public deed before a Notary.
required_dossiers: Private incorporation document (original signed copies)
Homonimia certificate
Identification documents of shareholders (passport for non-residents, with apostille where applicable)
SAGRILAFT/AML due-diligence information of the beneficial owners
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry observes missing clauses or defective signatures, execute a supplementary private document correcting the omissions; for public deeds, request notarial re-attestation of the corrective amendment.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial registration with the Chamber of Commerce and issuance of the existence certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social (RUES registry office)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the executed incorporation instrument together with the registration forms and payment of the mercantile registration tariff. The chamber verifies statutory compliance, inscribes the company in the Registro Mercantil and issues the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal, which evidences legal personality and the powers of the legal representative. The filing automatically triggers NIT pre-assignment in RUES.
required_dossiers: Incorporation instrument (private or public deed)
Certificado de Homonimia
Registro Único Empresarial application form with cadastral data of the registered office
Proof of payment of registration fees
Identity documents of shareholders and legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, cure the identified defect (missing payment, wrong cadastral code, incomplete identification) and re-submit through the chamber's corrective filing procedure within the legal term.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax registration with DIAN: NIT and RUT
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales) through the Web RUES portal or authorized DIAN offices
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon registration in RUES, the NIT is automatically assigned. Complete and validate the RUT electronically, declaring the principal economic activity CIIU 3240, the ordinary income-tax regime of the SAS, and the obligations as of day one: electronic invoicing (factura electrónica), withholding agent duties, and mandatory annual transfer-pricing documentation if applicable. Appoint the legal representative as the responsible party and certify the electronic invoicing software.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal (valid recent issue)
RUT registration form completed online
Identity document of legal representative and shareholders
Electronic invoicing technical certification file (if applicable)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any RUT discrepancy is corrected via the Web RUES portal or an in-person DIAN update; fines for late or wrong registrations are procedurally cured by submission of corrective declarations and payment of applicable minor penalties.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal enrollment for industry and commerce tax (ICA) and complementary levies
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Secretaría de Hacienda (e.g., Secretaría Distrital de Hacienda of Bogotá) via the virtual tax office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Enroll the SAS in the municipal taxpayer registry (RIT) declaring the ICA activity code for manufacturing, the registered workshop address, and the expected gross revenue bracket. The enrollment creates the municipal tax account and determines the monthly/annual ICA declaration schedule. Verify consistency with the property file (catastro) of the workshop premises.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
RUT evidencing ICA activity
Lease agreement or deed proving possession of the workshop premises
Municipal intellectual/cadastral certificate of the property
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If rejected due to cadastral mismatch, submit the stamped lease or updated predial certificate to the local treasury; a corrective enrollment through the virtual office cures the defect.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Employer and social security affiliation (when hiring personnel)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: ARL (Administradora de Riesgos Laborales), EPS, pension fund, Caja de Compensación Familiar, and Ministry of Labor through the PILA system
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the SAS as an employer in the PILA platform and affiliate the legal representative and workers with a risk administrator using the CIIU 3240 occupational risk classification for epoxy-resin handling; affiliate employees with an EPS, a pension fund (Colpensiones or an AFP) and the compensation fund of the domicile. Complete the FURAT form and declare the risk class to activate labor insurance coverage.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
RUT
FURAT risk classification form
Workers' identification and affiliation forms
PILA registration record
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If an ARL rejects the risk classification, request reclassification to the correct CIIU 3240 category by submitting a process description (resin mixing, casting, curing, sanding); effective coverage is backdated once PILA contributions are paid.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of the corporate bank account and payment-rail integration (Kickstarter/Stripe/PayPal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Colombian commercial bank (licensing body: Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia) and the respective payment processors
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a corporate bank account presenting the registration certificate and bylaws, with an approved signatory matrix of the legal representative. For cross-border proceeds, open a USD-denominated account subject to Bank of the Republic foreign-exchange rules. For the payment rails, complete Stripe and PayPal underwriting using the legal entity data, beneficial-owner KYC, bank statements and the Kickstarter campaign profile; upload the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal to each processor.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal valid within 30 days
Bylaws and incorporation instrument
RUT
Passport and apostilled incorporation papers of non-resident shareholders
Bank account application and signature authorization forms
Kickstarter campaign URL, business plan and projected revenue for processor underwriting
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank demands enhanced KYC, provide source-of-funds affidavits and contractual evidence of the Kickstarter campaign; if a payment processor withholds funds, file a formal compliance appeal submitting the current Chamber of Commerce certificate, the industrial license permits and the e-invoicing records.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) and the regional environmental authority Corporación Autónoma Regional (CAR) of the production site; municipal urban licensing through the Curaduría Urbana
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Certificado de Uso del Suelo (land-use certificate) for the workshop, plus the Permiso de Vertimientos and Permiso de Emisiones Atmosféricas for the epoxy casting operation

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministerio de Ambiente y Desarrollo Sostenible - Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Registration tier - small-scale micro-workshop manufacturing of epoxy resin dice: subject to the Registro Único Ambiental (RUA) and simplified emission/effluent permits; a full Estudio de Impacto Ambiental (EIA) is required only if installed capacity or VOC release exceeds the thresholds of Decreto 1076 de 2015
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater: strict compliance with Resolución 0631 de 2015 national effluent limits for discharges to municipal sewers - pH 6.0-9.0, total suspended solids ≤ 100 mg/L, BOD5 ≤ 100 mg/L, phenolic compounds ≤ 0.5 mg/L; process wastewater from resin cleaning must not be poured into sinks without treatment. Air: VOC and particulate ceilings under Resolución 909 de 2008 for stationary sources, with local exhaust ventilation and carbon filtration required for the curing area. Hazardous waste: uncured resin, contaminated PPE and sanding dust must be classified as hazardous waste under Decreto 1076 de 2015, stored in sealed containers and transported by an authorized waste handler with manifests retained for five years.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Certificado de Bomberos (fire safety certificate) mandating extinguishers, emergency exits and periodic fire inspections; workplace clearance under Decreto 1072 de 2015 (SGSST) covering structural load verification of workbenches, forced ventilation for epoxy fumes, documented chemical hygiene procedures, and supply of respirators, nitrile gloves and eye protection; the Certificado de Uso del Suelo issued by the Curaduría Urbana is the controlling clearance for operating a manufacturing activity at the registered premises.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) – official national tax and customs authority of Colombia; taxpayer portal: DIAN MUISCA (Modelo Único de Ingresos, Servicio y Control Automatizado) and DIAN website at www.dian.gov.co
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity or its local legal representative must first obtain a provisional tax identification number (NIT provisional) from DIAN by submitting the foreign company incorporation documents, the duly executed appointment of an attorney-in-fact (apoderado) resident in Colombia, and the completed official registration forms (Registro Único Tributario – RUT) online through MUISCA. After legalization of the local branch or subsidiary (SAS) before the Chamber of Commerce and notarization of bylaws, the company obtains its definitive NIT and updates the RUT with the assigned tax classification and address. The procedure requires an approved digital certificate or authorized power of attorney, and the DIAN issues the RUT containing the NIT, VAT registration status, ICA registration status, and applicable tax regime codes.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Colombia does not have a general check-the-box regime mirroring the U.S. A Colombian SAS is by default a corporation taxed at entity level under the Colombian income tax. No transparent entity election is available for a domestic SAS; however, taxpayers may elect to apply the special tax consolidation regime for groups (with prior authorization and meeting economic substance requirements). Hybrid mismatch rules under Colombian transfer pricing and CFC legislation may require aligning the local entity classification with the foreign tax classification of the same entity; mandatory disclosure or re-characterization may apply in cross-border payments subject to the OECD BEPS Action 2 recommendations.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: COP 0 (zero peso threshold for legal entities). Any person or entity engaged in selling goods or providing services subject to VAT, or importing goods, must register in the RUT and obtain a VAT responsibility code even if activities are occasional; however, small merchants under the SIMPLE regime may have an optional regime threshold of up to COP 3,500,000,000 in gross revenue for the SIMPLE taxation system; for standard VAT purposes there is no monetary exemption threshold for entities created as SAS.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: DIAN mandates electronic invoicing (factura electrónica) for all VAT-registered taxpayers. The system requires issuance of electronic invoices using authorized software or DIAN's free solution, transmission of the invoice XML to DIAN for validation and acceptance, assignment of a unique CUFE/CUDS code, and electronic submission of the validation events. Since 2021, taxpayers must transmit the electronic invoice in real time (at the moment of issuance) to the DIAN using web services under the electronic invoicing technical annex; there is no physical digital stamping, but the DIAN assigns an electronic validation code and records the invoice in its central system. A digital signature certificate is required, and non-compliance triggers penalties.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods and qualifying export services (including handcrafted goods sold abroad) are eligible for zero rating (excluded from VAT) under Colombian law. Eligibility requires that the exporter be a registered taxpayer, that the goods physically leave the country, that the sale is made to a foreign purchaser, and that the exporter obtains and preserves evidence of the export. For services, zero rating applies to services rendered in Colombia to non-residents that are used exclusively abroad or to services related to export goods; supporting documentation must demonstrate the foreign beneficiary and the off-shore use or exploitation. The exporter must complete the export process through the customs system and present the proofs to DIAN.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación / DEX) accepted by DIAN and the customs authority
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill (or other transport document proving physical departure from Colombian territory)
Inward Remittance Certificate (Certificado de Compensación de Divisas or bank confirmation evidencing the export proceeds were repatriated to Colombia through authorized foreign exchange channels)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN may deny VAT zero rating or the VAT refund claim if the documentation is incomplete, inconsistent, or does not prove the actual export and the effective exchange repatriation. The deadline for repatriating export proceeds is generally 180 days from the export date (subject to extensions by the Central Bank). Failure to repatriate within the deadline may result in recomputation of the VAT and application of the general VAT rate, plus interest and a penalty equal to up to 200% of the omitted tax in cases of fraudulent or fictitious exports. False claims for VAT refunds can trigger criminal tax fraud charges, fines equivalent to 100%-200% of the refunded amount, retroactive clawbacks up to the last five taxable years, and disqualification from refund programs.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (BANREP) is the sole monetary and exchange authority, empowered under Law 9 of 1991, Decree 1068 of 2015 (Title 11 of the Regulatory Decree of the National Public Administration), Decree 1735 of 1993 as amended, and Circular Reglamentaria Externa DCIN-83. The exchange regime is operationally supervised by the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) over authorized intermediaries; the DIAN oversees foreign trade documentation and import/export declarations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Colombian peso (COP) operates under a managed floating regime with full current-account convertibility for goods, services, and ordinary transfers, provided transactions are channelled through authorized exchange market intermediaries. Capital-account operations, notably foreign direct investment, are freely permitted but registration with BANREP, normally effected via the receiving bank, is a statutory precondition for the subsequent remittance of dividends and repatriation of capital. Profit remittances to non-resident shareholders are not subject to exchange-licensing but require the FDI registration to be in force and an exchange declaration to accompany the outward transfer. No quantitative limits apply to current-account settlements, yet all flows must be executed through the formal exchange market at the Tasa Representativa del Mercado (TRM).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Exporters of physical goods must channel all export proceeds into the Colombian exchange market through an authorized intermediary within six months from the date of shipment; an extension of up to three additional months may be justified to BANREP in duly supported circumstances. Each collection must be reported in the Declaración de Cambio por Exportación de Bienes prepared by the receiving bank as the transfer is liquidated. Since April 2024, under Decree 253 of 2024, goods exporters are additionally obliged to convert at least 20% of the foreign currency collected into COP on the formal exchange market, the remaining balance being freely held in permitted foreign-currency accounts or a registered compensation account for the balance of the channelling term. Failure to surrender or channel within the statutory term exposes the exporter to exchange-regime penalties and loss of export incentives.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (COP current account) with adjunct USD-denominated account for export proceeds
Operational Account (COP current account) with foreign trade and FX desk services
Operational Account (COP/USD dual-structure) with derivative hedging line
Operational Account (COP current account) with USD collection through Davivienda Panama network
Operational Account (COP current account) with USD clearing via Scotiabank New York correspondent
Operational Account only; limited FX and international trade infrastructure

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium as a collection accelerator, Low as a standalone treasury channel. Foreign digital EMIs, including Wise, Payoneer, Airwallex, and Mercury, are not licensed to in Colombia and therefore cannot open local COP accounts, issue local IBANs, or act as authorized intermediaries of the exchange market; balances parked in such EMIs are treated for exchange purposes as funds held abroad. They may be viable as a short-term USD settlement gateway for Stripe and PayPal payouts when the proceeds are periodically repatriated into a registered compensation account or a local bank's foreign-currency segment within the six-month export channelling deadline. Local SEDPE fintechs, such as Nequi, Daviplata, and Lulo Bank, are regulated payment institutions but are not authorized exchange intermediaries and cannot satisfy the export surrender obligation on their own.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote onboarding is legally permitted in principle under Law 2111 of 2021 and SFC digital customer-onboarding rules, using biometric verification, electronic signatures, and video interviews; however, major commercial banks retain discretion to require an in-person signature protocol for the legal representative, foreign beneficial owners, and account signatories who are non-residents. In practice, a single physical visit by the legal representative to the chosen bank's corporate desk in Bogotá, Medellín, or Barranquilla is strongly recommended to complete signature registration, the Declaración de Beneficiario Final, and the original-document review (RUT, Cámara de Comercio certificate, passports, and the SAS bylaws). Non-resident directors who cannot attend must grant a notarized power of attorney that is legalized or apostilled, with the bank reserving the right to validate the underlying business purpose.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large inbound remittances from crowdfunding platform (Kickstarter) to a newly incorporated SAS with no prior banking record, including thousands of small individual pledges classified as e-commerce proceeds.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Kickstarter campaign and payout statements, the platform's merchant agreement, itemized pledge and reward fulfilment report, shipping manifests and courier tracking, the DIAN export declarations covering each batch, individual sales invoices, refund policy, product catalog, and a corporate resolution authorizing the open-account export model.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Recurring PayPal and Stripe settlements from multiple geographies without conventional commercial contracts, raising suspicion of unstructured money movement or unregistered payment intermediation.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Merchant statements and settlement reports from PayPal and Stripe, verified merchant identification, chargeback and refund history, IP and transaction geo-location analytics, proof of physical goods shipment, a customer-facing e-commerce invoice template, and a signed affidavit confirming the absence of third-party payment intermediation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership opacity due to non-resident shareholders holding the SAS through intermediate holding companies or nominee structures.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Declaración de Beneficiario Final filed with the SFC, an updated corporate structure chart identifying all natural persons with direct or indirect control above 10%, passport or cédula de extranjería copies, proof of legal source of funds for the equity contribution, and a sworn statement from the legal representative describing the commercial rationale of the ownership chain.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Product classification concern: polyhedral dice may be mischaracterized as gambling paraphernalia by AML and VASP-questionnaire filters.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: ISIC 3240 and NAICS 339930 classification certificate, product brochures and unboxing documentation, trademark registration for the dice brand, marketing materials demonstrating tabletop RPG use, and a written external legal opinion confirming the product is a gaming accessory rather than an instrument of gambling.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Equity capital from the non-resident shareholder must arrive by SWIFT MT103 in USD or EUR to the SAS's local COP or USD account held at an authorized intermediary bank. The remittance must reference the foreign direct investment concept, and the receiving bank will generate the BANREP exchange declaration and the Registro de Inversiones Internacionales (RII) within the applicable statutory window, normally five business days. The dossier for the bank must include the shareholder resolution approving the capital contribution, the SAS articles of incorporation as amended, source-of-funds documentation, the wire instruction with the correct FDI purpose code, and a letter confirming the intended use of funds for working capital and raw-material procurement. The RII certificate must be retained indefinitely as it is the legal precondition for future dividend remittances and capital repatriation.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: International trade settlements will predominantly run through SWIFT MT103 wires from the entity's COP/USD account with same-day FX conversion at the intermediary's TRM-based rate. For raw material purchases, the bank requires the commercial invoice, packing list, and, where applicable, the import customs declaration submitted through DIAN; banks may accept an open-account clean payment order for repeated small-value procurements from the same supplier. When suppliers demand security, an irrevocable documentary letter of credit can be opened at the commercial bank, with the beneficiary drawing against transport documents and an independent inspection certificate. Dividend remittances to the non-resident shareholder must also be executed via the exchange market to the RII-linked account, supported by audited financial statements confirming distributable profits and the applicable dividend withholding settlement.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: COP/USD deliverable forward contracts traded with an authorized local bank or brokerage to lock export receivables against TRM volatility
FX swaps on TRM with authorized intermediaries for managing short-term USD liquidity mismatches between payout cycles and raw-material payments
Cross-currency interest rate swaps for medium-term trade finance where a fixed-rate USD liability is converted to COP or vice versa
Vanilla currency options purchased through a supervised local intermediary to protect against adverse TRM movements while retaining upside
Offshore NDFs are not permissible for onshore residents; all hedging must be booked with a supervised Colombian counterparty and have demonstrable economic hedging intent

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual renewal of mercantile registration (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Local Cámara de Comercio competent for the registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually from 1 January through 31 March of each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal triggers a Chamber-imposed surcharge/fine calculated on the number of months of delay; persistent non-renewal can lead to cancellation of the mercantile registration and administrative strike-off of the company.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Holding of the annual ordinary shareholders' meeting and approval of the year-end financial statements and management report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Corporate record/minutes book; subsequent deposit with the Cámara de Comercio
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No later than 31 March following the 31 December fiscal year-end, i.e. within three months after the close of the fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to hold the meeting and approve the financial statements leaves the company's accounts unapproved, exposes administrators to liability, and enables the Superintendence of Companies to impose fines and order compliance.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Deposit of the duly approved financial statements (estados financieros) and related corporate acts in the commercial registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio with jurisdiction over the registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month after approval by the shareholders; calendar-year companies generally by late April if the meeting is held at the 31 March statutory deadline
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-deposit constitutes an administrative irregularity; the company may be fined by the Superintendence of Companies and the registry record remains incomplete, blocking subsequent corporate registrations.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return and settlement (Declaración de Renta y Complementarios)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due according to the annual DIAN tax calendar for legal entities, normally between mid-February and mid-April depending on the taxpayer's NIT
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing attracts fines up to 5% of the tax due per month or fraction of month, plus default interest; continued non-filing may lead to tax assessment, enforced collection, and criminal proceedings for intentional evasion.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual beneficial-owner (UBO) report (Reporte de Beneficiarios Finales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually following the fiscal year-end, within the term established by the applicable DIAN resolution; for calendar-year entities the filing is generally due by the end of February
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file, late filing, or inaccurate UBO information is subject to monetary fines, possible fiscal enforcement measures, and AML-related reputational and administrative consequences.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: For a Colombian S.A.S., a statutory auditor (Revisor Fiscal) is mandatory when shareholders decide it, or when gross income or total assets in the immediately preceding fiscal year equal or exceed 3,000 monthly minimum legal wages (SMMLV). At the 2025 SMMLV of COP 1,423,500, the threshold is COP 4,270,500,000 (approximately USD 1,040,000).
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Colombian financial reporting standards under Law 1314/2009, Decreto 2420/2015 and amendments: full IFRS, IFRS for SMEs, or the simplified microenterprise accounting framework, depending on the entity's size classification.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The S.A.S. must keep the register of members current and record every share transfer in that statutory register before the transfer is enforceable against the company. For UBO purposes, shareholding and control structure must be confirmed and reported to DIAN annually; any qualifying transfer or change of ultimate ownership must also be reflected in the annual confirmation and may require an updated UBO filing within the relevant statutory window.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members/Shareholders (Libro de Registro de Accionistas)
Minute Book of General Shareholders' Meetings (Libro de Actas de Asamblea)
Minute Book of Board of Directors or equivalent management committee, if a board exists
Supporting accounting books and commercial records required under Colombian commercial law

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 120–300 per year in provincial cities; USD 200–600 per year in Bogotá for a registered office/agent service; no cost if the company uses its own premises
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500–3,500 for a voluntary independent review or certified audit of a low-asset S.A.S.; not mandatory below the Revisor Fiscal threshold

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: None (no general tax holidays or preferential sectoral rates for tabletop gaming accessories manufacturing under ISIC 3240); standard 35% corporate income tax (CIT) on net taxable income; 25% additional deduction available for certified investments in science, technology and innovation (CTeI); annual tax-loss offset restricted to 25% of net taxable income (schema-standardized carryforward metric: 5 years).
